EventPayload.description: Base class for typed payloads. Subclasses are registered with ``@event``.
EventPayload.title: EventPayload

payload.description:
An agent took up a position: its role, and the department that comes with it.

The realtime reducer rebuilds an agent from ``AGENT_CREATED`` alone, so this is the only
thing that can move a drawn agent to another room without a full snapshot reload.
payload.title: AgentAssigned

payload.description:
Explicit return to IDLE.

- ``initialized``: activity row created for a new agent
- ``failure_acknowledged``: a human acknowledged a FAILED run
- ``waiting_cleared``: the wait ended without a new run (task cancelled)
- ``run_ended``: the run ended without a final failure (retry scheduled, lease reclaimed
  after a worker crash, task cancelled); the agent is free again

Not emitted when a COMPLETED display period simply expires; that is a projection rule
(logs/3d-office/02_AGENT_STATE_MODEL.md §5).
payload.title: AgentIdle

payload.description: The agent left the roster: no new work, and the office stops drawing it.
payload.title: AgentRetired

payload.description: An article's readers for a day changed (T-516, hourly; the raw beacons are not events).
payload.title: AnalyticsDailyUpdated

payload.description: The first draft of a story's article (later drafts are new versions of it).
payload.title: ArticleCreated

payload.description: The editor's decision on a draft (T-511): ``accept`` sends it on to approval.
payload.title: ArticleReviewed

payload.description: Raised by the runtime cost guard when a model call would exceed a hard budget.
payload.title: BudgetExhausted

payload.description:
Spending is close to a cap but has not hit it (platform/07 §5).

A warning, not a block: the cost guard is what refuses a call at 100%. This exists so the
approach is visible before the refusal, in the timeline and in the next snapshot.
payload.title: BudgetWarning

payload.description:
A business stopped spending. By a rule, by the CEO, or by a person — ``trigger`` says
which, the same way a project's pause does.
payload.title: BusinessUnitPaused

payload.description: Capital moved into (or out of) a business that is already running (T-611).
payload.title: BusinessUnitScaled

payload.description: The end of a business. Irreversible, so only a person can do it.
payload.title: BusinessUnitWoundDown

payload.description: Passed the deterministic fact-check (the editor still judges the meaning).
payload.title: ClaimVerified

payload.description:
Somebody started paying (T-612). The payload carries no personal data either: the
provider's reference and what kind of customer they are is all the company keeps.
payload.title: CustomerAcquired

payload.description: A new snapshot (a re-fetch of identical content reuses the old one and emits nothing).
payload.title: EvidenceCaptured

payload.description: Somebody noticed something that might be a business. Nothing has been spent on it yet.
payload.title: OpportunityDiscovered

payload.description: Its conclusion went stale. The market moved on while nobody decided.
payload.title: OpportunityExpired

payload.description: Kept on purpose: a company that forgets why it said no pays to find out twice.
payload.title: OpportunityRejected

payload.description: A number for comparing opportunities. Not a decision — the decision is its own event.
payload.title: OpportunityScored

payload.description: One observation attached to an opportunity. The company stores it without reading it.
payload.title: OpportunitySignalRecorded

payload.description:
Money a provider says arrived (T-701). The ledger's REVENUE_RECORDED follows it in the
same transaction; this one says where the money came from, that one what it counts as.
payload.title: PaymentReceived

payload.description: Frozen from here: an approval must point at the exact thing that was approved.
payload.title: ProposalSubmitted

payload.description: A newer version of the same proposal was submitted.
payload.title: ProposalSuperseded

payload.description: Archivable (03 §3): one per new item, so a timeline can show what came in.
payload.title: SourceItemDiscovered

payload.description: A customer began paying a price (T-701). Provider references only, as for customers.
payload.title: SubscriptionStarted

ProducedRef.description: A domain artifact created by a tool call, e.g. {type: "evidence", id: ...}.
ProducedRef.title: ProducedRef

payload.description: A loop added another round of tasks (T-514), e.g. a revision after the editor's review.
payload.title: WorkflowRunExtended
